translation: AI-assisted translation (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-15). Index-relative entries are DEFERRED (owner priority change: no ETF-for-index substitution); they originally used ETF PROXIES that exist as local candles: Nifty 50 -> NIFTYBEES-EQ, Nifty Bank -> BANKBEES-EQ, Nifty IT -> ITBEES-EQ (tracking error and ETF fees apply; recorded as APPROXIMATION). Cross-sectional 'top decile of the universe' rules are translated as time-series thresholds (APPROXIMATION) because no point-in-time universe exists. F&O, options, VIX, institutional-flow and delivery rules are BLOCKED with the exact data requirement.
